scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && concurrently --kill-others -n contracts,db,api,web "pnpm --filter @snode/contracts dev" "pnpm --filter @snode/db dev" "pnpm --filter @snode/api dev" "pnpm --filter @snode/web dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:packages && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm typecheck:characters
scripts.test: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @snode/api test && pnpm test:characters
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
